settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your Snow Media Center experience

contentBar.title: Content Bar
contentBar.description: Shows trending Plex titles and live sports on the home screen. Turn off on slower devices for a smoother experience.

player.title: Player (Live TV)
player.description: Global kill-switch for the Player section (Live TV, Movies & Series). When off, the Player card is hidden on every device.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the app language. Translation coverage is still being expanded.

aiTier.descPremium: Free is included. Premium uses the most powerful model for AI Chat and voice commands — {{gems}} Snow Gems a message. Switch any time to compare.
aiTier.descSignIn: Free is included. Sign in to try Premium, the most powerful model (paid with Snow Gems).

dashboardSize.title: Large dashboard
dashboardSize.description: Off, the Dashboard fits on one screen. On, everything is bigger and easier to read from the couch, and the page scrolls.

postNotify.title: Post notifications
postNotify.description: On, a new post from Snow Media shows a count on the Support card and a heads-up on the home screen. Off, it still arrives under Support → Posts, quietly.

deviceAlerts.title: Alerts on this device
deviceAlerts.description: On by default. Service notices pop up on screen even when Snow Media Center is closed — press OK on one to open the app, or dismiss it and it stays gone. Turn this off to keep alerts inside the app only.
deviceAlerts.blocked: Notifications are switched off for this app in your device settings, so nothing will show until you turn them back on there.

remote.title: Use your phone as a remote
remote.step1: Scan the QR code with your phone's camera, or go to <1>snowmediaent.com/remote</1>
remote.step2: Enter the code shown here, then choose Allow on the TV
remote.step3: Move, select, go back, play/pause, type and talk — right from your phone
remote.paired: A phone is paired — open snowmediaent.com/remote on it to use it.
remote.stayPaired: Paired phones stay paired; each code works once.
remote.typingHintTitle: Show the QR code when typing
remote.typingHintDesc: A small card offers your phone's keyboard whenever a text box is open on the TV.

profiles.switchDesc: Pick another profile. Each one has its own Continue Watching, My List, favourites and home screen.
profiles.manageDesc: Add someone (up to 8 profiles), make a Kids profile, rename, change the colour, or add a PIN.

toast.aiSignInDesc: Snow AI Premium uses Snow Gems from your account.
toast.notifBlockedDesc: Allow notifications for Snow Media Center in your device settings, then try again.
toast.alertsOnDesc: Service notices will pop up even when Snow Media Center is closed.
toast.alertsOffDesc: Alerts will only show inside the app.
toast.unpairedDesc: Pair again with the new code.
